blocks.text: A new chapter for outdoor and lifestyle enthusiasts is officially on the horizon as R.O.X. unveils its highly anticipated board-up in Bonifacio Global City, signaling the upcoming launch of a bigger and better R.O.X. this November. The reveal has generated overwhelming excitement and support from customers, outdoor enthusiasts, brand partners, and the wider R.O.X. community. Following the announcement of its temporary closure earlier this year, the board-up has sparked curiosity and anticipation for what is set to be an exciting new destination for adventure, outdoor, and lifestyle experiences in the heart of BGC.
